set.body:
## Objective and scope

Profile the selected method on representative observed data and optimize only measured bottlenecks before final qualification.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Record phase/kernel timing, allocation and peak process memory on named hardware with fixed threads, including the common reference and difficult/failure cases.
2. Optimize buffer reuse and hot kernels only where measured; verify numerical equivalence within predeclared tolerances and preserve geometry/anatomy regression behavior.
3. Publish explicit runtime/memory envelopes and failure handling; any changed numerical behavior returns through policy selection and stress checks before Q02.
4. Keep native/emulated timings separate and document scalability. Shared provider changes require existing ownership, reusable contracts and relevant consumer evidence.

## Planned areas

- modules/reframe4s-halfflow/
- benchmarks/flashalign/
- docs/benchmarks/

## Blocking prerequisites

- G4 (`bd-01M4X4DX5Q6MBZCYTY4RQ85AHN`)

## Evidence and safeguards

Use Mote claims/path reservations when implementation begins. Preserve unrelated dirty work and immutable historical studies. Reuse canonical providers and current owners. Keep labels/evaluation-only masks out of fitting, tuning on qualification data, and runtime stopping. Record exact source/provider/input/config identities, commands, numerical tolerances and all failures; run affected JVM/Scala.js and independent numerical checks. Current geometry/export thresholds cannot be relaxed to improve a pass rate. Completed research may be negative; milestone/epic acceptance remains a separate evidence-based decision.

## References

- docs/benchmarks/real-image-development.md (2026-10-11 accumulated-smoothing and backtracking studies)
- docs/halfflow-capability-ledger.md
- Existing refinement issue bd-01M4NVC83PEY6F4GSGDRD6RFBH and full-boundary issue bd-01M2EG25H20DR7CXNHK22ZF4VE
- Same-affine reference: docs/benchmarks/evidence/real-mri-calibration-20261011/reference-results.json
- SyN method: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2276735/
- Independent evaluation reference: https://github.com/JHU-MedImage-Reg/LUMIR_L2R
